items.rationale: The fixed unit suffered lightning-surge damage under 2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Sections 7.1.9–7.1.10 limit the 7.1 kW upgrade to €1,400 gross for an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, benchmarked to Case 38.
Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary installation and commissioning at the pre-loss specification, not extra work required by the upgrade. Case 38 supports €478 gross for the line.

Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the entire console charge because it was chosen for appearance and was not required for installation. The positive estimate is a conditional benchmark for an ordinary support, not an allowance for this console.
Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage at the rate for the equivalent 3.5 kW unit. Case 38 supports €42 gross, excluding the separately billed express surcharge.
Section 7.1.12 excludes the full timed-delivery surcharge absent advance insurer approval or a need to prevent further loss, neither of which is stated.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the full separately billed paperwork fee as contractor overhead rather than a reinstatement cost.
